title: Grade Calculator
description: Calculate letter grades, grade points, GPA, class averages, and grade distribution reports.

steps.title: Letter grade
steps.description: Write a `letterGrade` function that returns the letter grade: A (90+), B (80-89), C (70-79), D (60-69), F (<60).
hints: Use if/else if/else for each range
90+ is A, 80-89 is B, 70-79 is C, 60-69 is D, below 60 is F

steps.title: Grade point value
steps.description: Write a `gradePoint` function that returns the GPA points: A=4, B=3, C=2, D=1, F=0.
hints: Map each letter grade to its point value
Use a switch statement or if/else

verification.successMessage: A = 4 points, C = 2 points, F = 0 points!

steps.title: Calculate GPA
steps.description: Write a `calculateGPA` function that takes an array of letter grades and returns the GPA (average of grade points).
hints: Map each grade to its point value using gradePoint
Divide by the number of grades to get the average

verification.successMessage: GPA for A, B, C is (4+3+2)/3 = 3.0!

steps.title: Class average
steps.description: Write a `classAverage` function that takes an array of numeric scores and returns the average score.
hints: Divide by the number of scores

steps.title: Grade distribution report
steps.description: Write a `gradeDistribution` function that takes an array of scores and returns an object with counts of each letter grade.
hints: Use letterGrade to convert each score
Count how many of each grade in an object

verification.successMessage: Grade distribution: A:3, B:3, C:2, D:1, F:1!
verification.failureMessage: The distribution should show counts for all five letter grades.
